scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps && npm run build:workers
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace packages/shared-types run build && npm --workspace packages/crypto-vault run build && npm --workspace packages/vietsub-sdk run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace apps/admin-portal run build && npm --workspace apps/vietsub-wasm-studio run build && npm --workspace apps/telegram-miniapp run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/shared-types run typecheck && npm --workspace workers/central-dispatcher run typecheck
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply hendy_vietsub --local --config workers/central-dispatcher/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply hendy_vietsub --remote --config workers/central-dispatcher/wrangler.jsonc
